answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity proof-of-work stamp. To transact, an agent hashes a rotating challenge until it finds a signal — a nonce whose digest clears a strict threshold — and that stamp is logged on-chain. Each extra identity costs real compute, so an attacker cannot mint thousands of wallets for free. Reputation is also discounted: only agents attested by unrelated peers earn a saffron badge, while a pigment score counts distinct reviewed contributions per key. A sybil farm must pay mining and reputation effort per alias; an honest agent pays once and reuses its standing.
